title: GoHighLevel Expert Needed - CRM Automation, Workflows & KPI Dashboards

facts: Post: growing medical wellness clinic already on GoHighLevel with basic workflows, calendars and CRM tools.
Post goals: automate repetitive tasks, improve lead conversion and patient retention, clear visibility of key business metrics.

Post scope: lead follow-up and booking workflows; reminders, missed appointments, patient follow-ups, feedback requests; service pipelines; retention, membership tracking and reactivation; dashboards for leads, appointments, conversion, revenue, lead sources, membership growth, cancellations, retention; weekly and monthly executive dashboards; no duplicate or conflicting workflows; documentation and training.
Post prefers milestones: audit and plan, automation, dashboards, testing, training. HIPAA familiarity preferred.
Post states no contact name; greeting and cover stay generic until Lorenzo rules on review-sourced names.

metrics.name: Enquiries that book a consultation
metrics.aim: Book more of the leads you already get
metrics.definition: New enquiries in a period that book a consultation within an agreed window, divided by all new enquiries in that period, reported by lead source.

metrics.name: Missed appointment rate
metrics.definition: Appointments marked no-show divided by all appointments scheduled in the period, with rebooked visits reported alongside.

metrics.name: Active member retention
metrics.definition: Members active at the start of the month who are still active at its end, divided by members active at the start, with cancellations listed separately.

scenes.title: Hannah books, misses, and rebooks by text.
scenes.caption: The booking text, the reminder and the rebooking text all sit in one conversation that Sophie can see.
scenes.beat: Here's what Hannah actually sees. Her first text has the booking link, and the day before, she gets a reminder. She misses the appointment, so an hour later she gets a friendly text to rebook. She picks Saturday, and the confirmation comes straight back. Sophie can see the whole thread, and none of these messages mention anything about her health.

scenes.title: Win back members before they cancel.
scenes.caption: When a member hasn't visited in 45 days, they get a check-in with a booking link, and Marcus gets a call task if they don't book.
scenes.beat: Now retention. Daniel is a member who hasn't been in since mid-September. When he hits 45 days without a visit, he gets tagged and receives a friendly check-in email with a booking link. Three days later, the workflow checks whether he booked. He did, so he moves back to Active in the membership pipeline. If he hadn't, Marcus, who looks after memberships, would get a task to call him.
details: 45 days without a visit → check-in email → wait 3 days
Booked → Active again · Not booked → call task for Marcus
